demos.title: Data to report
demos.description: Seeded CSV generation, Python aggregation, a Markdown/JSON report kept as a Directory artifact and archived by a nested graph. Includes an intentional failure switch.

demos.title: Collatz (C++ / Python)
demos.description: The same feedback loop implemented in C++ and Python inside two nested graphs, with merge, fork and branch. 27 reaches 1 after 111 steps; both sequences are compared and kept as a CSV file. The Collatz conjecture is explained on a note with formulas.

demos.title: Live Stream
demos.description: A seeded random walk sampled every 100 ms and drawn with Dawn as a live line chart, through a feedback loop that can be cancelled at any time.

demos.title: Cas A · Chandra RGB
demos.description: Chandra X-ray events of the supernova remnant Cassiopeia A, fixed by Nix (fetched once by hash from the HEASARC archive), split into three energy bands on a sky grid centred on Cas A and composed into an RGB image. ObsID 25628 (13 MB) by default; 114 is the deep 50 ks observation.

demos.title: Cas A · Chandra RGB（Draft）
demos.description: The same plan as Drafts only: a start Card and three Drafts that state what each step takes and gives, ready for the Agent's "Card を生成".

demos.title: GW150914 · 重力波
demos.description: The first binary black hole merger seen by LIGO: the public H1 and L1 strain data are fetched, whitened and shown as a chirp in a spectrogram. The pass band can be changed and that step rerun alone.

demos.description: The SARS-CoV-2 main protease with its inhibitor (PDB 6LU7): the structure is fetched from the PDB, drawn, and the residues within a distance of the ligand are listed.

demos.description: Kepler light curves of Kepler-6 are detrended and folded at the planet's period; the transit depth gives the planet's size relative to its star.
